Warranty Replacement Request – NerdQaxe++ Rev 6.1 (Order Shop····‑A)

To whom it may concern,

My NerdQaxe++ Rev 6.1 (6TH/s), Order *Shop····‑A*, has stopped
functioning. The fuse burned out, and I replaced it with a new one of the
same amperage. I tried several fuses, but the unit still will not power on.

The power supply is not the issue—I tested it with other bitcoin miners and
confirmed it works. I also attempted to use a different Mean Well power
supply with the affected unit, but it still does not turn on.

Can you advise on how to proceed with obtaining a replacement under the
warranty?

Thank you, Jesse

Hi Jesse,

Thanks for the detail, and sorry your NerdQaxe++ has gone down. You've already ruled out the obvious things: new fuses of the same rating, a known-good supply tested on other miners, and a second Mean Well unit. A board that won't power on after all of that is a hardware fault, and that is what the warranty is for.

Here is what happens next. Your case is with the team for the warranty approval, and a colleague picks it up today at 10am Eastern. As soon as it's approved I'll send you the prepaid return label and the return reference to write on the outside of the box, and your replacement is reserved so it goes out as soon as your unit reaches our warehouse. You'll get all of that by email in this thread, so there's nothing you need to send again.

One thing I do need from you: can you confirm whether the unit was ever overclocked or modified in any way? Running stock keeps it fully covered, and that answer lets us move straight to the label.

Sorry again for the trouble with this one.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Thanks, I'll keep an eye out for the follow-up.

- Jesse B.,

Jesse K.

Hi Jesse,

Thanks for bearing with us. Your return is being reviewed for approval now, and the team will confirm it by email shortly, today once they are in from 10am Eastern.

Once it's approved you'll get the prepaid return label in this thread along with the return reference to write on the outside of the box, and we'll take it from there.

One thing that will speed it up: let us know whether the unit was ever overclocked or modified. Running it stock keeps it fully covered, so a quick yes or no in reply is all we need.

Sorry again that this one let you down.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

It was not overclocked. In fact, it was probably under clocked, never
reaching 6.1Th.

Best,

Jesse K.

Hi Jesse,

That's good to know, thank you. Stock or underclocked keeps it fully covered, so nothing about how you ran it counts against the warranty here, and I've noted it on your file.

Nothing else is needed from you for now. The approval is with the team and they'll confirm it by email in this thread today, once they're in from 10am Eastern. The prepaid return label and the reference for the box come with that confirmation.

In the meantime, please keep the unit and its box as they are, and don't try any further fuses, so it reaches us in the state it failed in.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Sarah,

I haven't heard back from the approval team yet.  Any updates?

- Jesse

Hi Jesse,

You're right to chase, and I'm sorry. You wrote in on the 23rd and the sign-off should not have taken until now. That's on us, not on you.

Where it stands: your fault has been validated as a hardware failure, your file shows the unit was never overclocked, and there is no question about the warranty covering it. The only thing outstanding is the internal approval, and I've put it in front of the team again just now with everything they need, so it's being picked up today.

The moment it lands, your return goes out in this thread: a prepaid USPS label from your address in (address hidden) to our Tennessee warehouse, with the reference Shop···· to write on the outside of the box. Your replacement is held against that return and ships as soon as your unit reaches us.

Nothing further is needed from you in the meantime.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Thank you for the quick response Sarah!

Best,

Jesse K.

Hi Jesse,

My pleasure. Nothing more needed from you for now, just sit tight and keep the unit and its box as they are.

As soon as the approval lands you'll get the prepaid label and the Shop···· reference right here in this thread, and I'll stay on it until it does.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Thank you very much, Sarah! I'll get right on it. Have a good day

Best,

Jesse K.

Hi Jesse,

I'll be watching for it on our side and will let you know here when it arrives and when your Hammer BC04 goes out.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
